result.instructions: Tools for UpCloud, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes UpCloud data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run upcloud_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run upcloud_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run upcloud_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. upcloud_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: upcloud_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The calling account: username, remaining credits and resource limits (cores, memory, storage per tier, IPs, networks, managed services). A cheap way to confirm the token works. UpCloud: GET /1.3/account.

tools.name: upcloud_list_zones
tools.title: List zones
tools.description: Available zones (data centres) with id (e.g. fi-hel1, de-fra1, us-chi1), description and whether they are public or private-cloud. Zone ids are used by every other resource. UpCloud: GET /1.3/zone.

tools.name: upcloud_list_plans
tools.title: List server plans
tools.description: Fixed-price server plans: name (e.g. 2xCPU-4GB), cores, memory, included storage size/tier and transfer, plus GPU model/amount for GPU plans. UpCloud: GET /1.3/plan.

tools.name: upcloud_list_prices
tools.title: List prices
tools.description: The price list per zone in the account's currency: per-hour prices for plans, cores, memory, storage tiers, backups, IPv4 addresses and traffic. UpCloud: GET /1.3/price.

tools.name: upcloud_get_billing_summary
tools.title: Get monthly billing summary
tools.description: Billing summary for one month with per-resource details (servers, storages, managed databases, object storage, …: amount, hours, plan, zone, labels) and totals. Needs an account allowed to read billing. UpCloud: GET /1.3/account/billing/summary/{yearmonth}.

resource_id.description: Only this resource: its UUID, or for IP addresses the address itself.

tools.name: upcloud_list_servers
tools.title: List servers
tools.description: Cloud servers on the account (summary: uuid, title, hostname, zone, plan, cores, memory, state, tags, labels). Filter by state, a free-text search (name, title, uuid, zone, IP, hostname, tag or template), tags or labels. Use upcloud_get_server for IPs and disks. UpCloud: GET /1.3/server.

search.description: Match by name, title, uuid, zone, IP address, hostname, tag name or template name.

tag.description: Tag filter: `a,b` matches servers with ANY of the tags, `a:b` servers with ALL of them.

label.description: Label filters: a key (`env`) or key=value (`env=prod`). Several are ANDed. Keys match case-insensitively.

limit.description: Max servers to return (use with offset to page).

tools.name: upcloud_get_server
tools.title: Get server details
tools.description: Full details of one server: state, plan, cores/memory, network interfaces and IP addresses, attached storage devices, firewall on/off, simple-backup schedule, labels, tags and remote-access settings. UpCloud: GET /1.3/server/{uuid}.

tools.name: upcloud_list_storages
tools.title: List storages
tools.description: Storage devices: disks, backups, CD-ROM images and OS templates (uuid, title, type, tier, size GB, state, zone, labels). Narrow by `kind`: private (yours), public (UpCloud-provided), normal (disks), backup, cdrom, template or favorite. UpCloud: GET /1.3/storage[/{kind}].

kind.description: Narrow the list. Omit for every accessible storage.

label.description: Label filters: a key (`env`) or key=value (`env=prod`). Several are ANDed. Keys match case-insensitively.

tools.name: upcloud_get_storage
tools.title: Get storage details
tools.description: Details of one storage: size, tier, state (e.g. online, backuping), encryption, the servers it is attached to, its backups and backup_rule. Poll this to follow a backup started with upcloud_create_storage_backup. UpCloud: GET /1.3/storage/{uuid}.

tools.name: upcloud_list_ip_addresses
tools.title: List IP addresses
tools.description: Every IP address on the account: address, family (IPv4/IPv6), access (public/utility/private), the server it is assigned to, zone, PTR record, floating flag and release policy. UpCloud: GET /1.3/ip_address.

tools.name: upcloud_list_firewall_rules
tools.title: List server firewall rules
tools.description: The firewall rules of one server in evaluation order (position, direction, action, family, protocol, address and port ranges, comment). Whether the firewall is enabled at all is the `firewall` field of upcloud_get_server. UpCloud: GET /1.3/server/{uuid}/firewall_rule.

tools.name: upcloud_list_networks
tools.title: List networks
tools.description: Networks visible to the account — public, utility and private SDN networks — with their IP subnets, DHCP settings, routes, attached servers and peerings. Optionally only one zone. UpCloud: GET /1.3/network/.

zone.description: Only networks in this zone, e.g. fi-hel1.

label.description: Label filters: a key (`env`) or key=value (`env=prod`). Several are ANDed. Keys match case-insensitively.

tools.name: upcloud_list_databases
tools.title: List managed databases
tools.description: Managed Database services (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Valkey, OpenSearch): uuid, title, type, plan, zone, state, component hosts/ports, backups and labels. Note the response can include connection URIs with credentials. UpCloud: GET /1.3/database.

label.description: Label filters: a key (`env`) or key=value (`env=prod`). Several are ANDed. Keys match case-insensitively.

tools.name: upcloud_list_load_balancers
tools.title: List managed load balancers
tools.description: Managed Load Balancer services with their frontends, backends and members, networks, plan, zone, configured status and operational state. UpCloud: GET /1.3/load-balancer.

label.description: Label filters: a key (`env`) or key=value (`env=prod`). Several are ANDed. Keys match case-insensitively.

tools.name: upcloud_list_kubernetes_clusters
tools.title: List Kubernetes clusters
tools.description: Managed Kubernetes clusters: name, uuid, zone, plan, state, network/CIDR, control-plane IP filter, labels and node groups (plan, count, state). UpCloud: GET /1.3/kubernetes.

tools.name: upcloud_list_object_storages
tools.title: List managed object storages
tools.description: Managed Object Storage (S3-compatible) services: uuid, name, region, configured status and operational state, public/private endpoints, custom domains and labels. UpCloud: GET /1.3/object-storage-2.

sort.description: Order of results; prefix - for descending (API default -created_at).

tools.name: upcloud_list_audit_logs
tools.title: List audit logs
tools.description: Security audit trail of the account (up to 180 days): who did what to which resource, when, from which IP and via API or Hub. Filter by action, origin, resource type, time window or a keyword (UUID, username or IP). Returns total_count for paging. UpCloud: GET /1.3/audit-logs.

created_after.description: ISO timestamp, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z (inclusive). Default 180 days ago.

q.description: Keyword: a resource UUID, account username or IP address.

tools.name: upcloud_start_server
tools.title: Start a server
tools.description: Start a stopped server (billing for a started server resumes). Fails with 409 if it is not stopped. `async` returns immediately — poll upcloud_get_server for state=started. UpCloud: POST /1.3/server/{uuid}/start.

start_type.description: sync (default) waits for the start; async returns at once.

tools.name: upcloud_stop_server
tools.title: Stop a server
tools.description: DISRUPTIVE: stop a running server — it goes offline until started again with upcloud_start_server. soft (default) sends an ACPI shutdown; with a timeout, a hard stop follows if it is still running. hard is like pulling the plug and can lose unsaved data. UpCloud: POST /1.3/server/{uuid}/stop.

stop_type.description: soft = ACPI shutdown signal (default); hard = equivalent of pulling the power cable.

tools.name: upcloud_restart_server
tools.title: Restart a server
tools.description: DISRUPTIVE: stop and start a running server. soft (default) needs a timeout: after it, timeout_action=destroy hard-stops and restarts, ignore (API default) aborts and leaves the server running. hard power-cycles immediately. UpCloud: POST /1.3/server/{uuid}/restart.

stop_type.description: soft = ACPI shutdown signal (default); hard = equivalent of pulling the power cable.

timeout.description: Soft-stop timeout in seconds, 1-600. Required for a soft restart.

timeout_action.description: What to do if the soft stop times out: destroy (hard stop, then start) or ignore (give up).

tools.name: upcloud_create_storage_backup
tools.title: Back up a storage
tools.description: Take an on-demand, point-in-time backup of a storage device. Additive (nothing is overwritten) but backups are billed per GB. Asynchronous: the storage goes to a backuping/maintenance state and back to online — poll upcloud_get_storage. UpCloud: POST /1.3/storage/{uuid}/backup.

title.description: A short description for the backup, 1-255 characters.

tools.name: upcloud_modify_server
tools.title: Rename a server / set its backup schedule
tools.description: Change a server's title, hostname and/or simple-backup schedule. Only these reversible fields are exposed — no resizing or plan change (billing) and no firewall toggle. simple_backup is `HHMM,daily|dailies|weeklies|monthlies` (UTC time) or `no` to disable. UpCloud: PUT /1.3/server/{uuid}.

simple_backup.description: e.g. 0430,dailies — or `no` to turn simple backups off.

annotations.title: Rename a server / set its backup schedule
